newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said on Friday it lowered the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$10.00/cubic metre or C$1.59/barrel, to C$167.00/cubic metre or C$26.55/barrel, effective immediately.

Other new prices were listed as follows: Cromer light sour C$159.00/cubic metre, or C$25.28/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$131.00/cubic metre, or C$20.83/barrel Midale at Cromer C$145.00/cubic metre, or C$23.53/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
